blocks.text: CALAPAN CITY, Oriental Mindoro — The unchecked clearing of forests and grasslands for farms, housing, businesses, and infrastructure continues to push the critically endangered Tamaraw to the brink, conservation leaders warned. The Mindoro Biodiversity Conservation Foundation Inc. (MBCFI) sounded the alarm during the Kapihan sa PIA Oriental Mindoro forum on September 29, noting that the dwindling and fragmentation of natural habitats is the single biggest threat to the endemic dwarf buffalo. MBCFI Executive Director Kathy Lene S. Cielo stressed that the Tamaraw’s low reproductive rate makes preserving what remains of its living space all the more urgent. The latest figures from […]...
